summary: Now and then an inaugural point puts a question to the audience and answers it at once, then pledges.
realLife: Questions are rare in inaugurals, about one point in fifty. When one comes, it is asked of the listeners and answered in the same point, and a pledge follows.
sources: John F. Kennedy, inaugural address, Jan 20, 1961: https://www.presidency.ucsb.edu/documents/inaugural-address-2
Read in full and coded point by point in docs/story/research/address-moves.md (Elections lane, Nov 24, 2026); that note is an extra line, the speeches are the sources.
